visual.general_description: Close clinical photograph of the axilla and raised proximal upper arm, with a hand touching the axillary region.
visual.detailed_description: A single portrait-oriented color photograph tightly frames exposed axillary skin and the proximal inner upper arm, raised diagonally toward the upper right. Several fingers cross the lower-left area and press or touch the skin below the axillary fold. Fine skin folds and short hair are visible. A narrow pale linear ridge/fold runs from the axillary region onto the inner arm. A small part of the face, hair and a necklace appears at the left edge; a blurred room and objects are in the background. There are no panel letters, arrows, scale bars, numerical measurements or printed labels.

visual.general_description: Follow-up clinical photograph of an exposed axilla with the arm raised.
visual.detailed_description: A single portrait-oriented color photograph shows the axillary fold and proximal inner upper arm, raised nearly vertically. The shoulder/torso is partly covered by a mustard-orange knit garment pulled away from the axilla, with a hand holding the garment at the bottom. Hair appears at the left edge and a plain pale wall occupies the right background. Fine skin creases and faint hair are visible, with no comparable prominent linear ridge evident in this view. There are no panel letters, arrows, scale bars, numerical measurements or printed labels. Framing, arm position and clothing differ from Figure 1.
